author: Houston Republic
title: Rice men's golf team earns at-large bid to NCAA Athens Regional
text:
The Rice Men’s Golf team earned the No. 10 seed for the NCAA Athens Regional, which will take place from May 18 to May 20 at the University of Georgia Golf Course in Athens, Georgia, according to a May 6 announcement.
This marks Rice’s first appearance at Regionals since 2014 and their eighth overall. It is also their first at-large berth since 2010. The selection is significant for the program as it reflects consistent performance throughout the season and recognition by the NCAA selection committee.
“This has been our goal all year,” said Rice Men’s Golf Head Coach Justin Emil. “From Day One, heading to Nationals is what we set out to do. This is just the next step for us. I’m excited for us to get back to work. It’s a testament to the guys. They work really hard day in, day out. I’m grateful for this group and everything they do every day.”
A total of 81 teams will compete across six regional sites, with the top five teams from each advancing to national finals at Omni La Costa Golf Resort in Carlsbad, California, from May 29 through June 3. The Owls have recorded four top-three finishes this year, including consecutive wins at both the Bayou City Collegiate Classic and Trinity Forest Invitational.
The Athens Regional field includes Auburn as the top seed among thirteen teams participating alongside Rice; other seeded teams include Illinois (No.2), Vanderbilt (No.3), BYU (No.4), Georgia (No.5), Louisville (No.6), Kansas (No.7), Northwestern (No.8), College of Charleston (No.9), Southern Miss (No.11), Harvard—who are Ivy League champions—(No.12) and Howard—the Northeast Conference champion—(No13). Ten individuals will also compete for one spot in championship finals.
Rice has faced four of its twelve regional opponents earlier this season with a combined record of one win and six losses against those teams.
